mcqs.question: Under the India–Canada trade discussions, what bilateral trade target has been set for 2030?
mcqs.explanation: India and Canada have set a target of US$50 billion in bilateral trade by 2030, alongside the aim of concluding the CEPA by the end of 2026. US$17 billion is the approximate current trade value, while C$32 billion is its approximate Canadian-dollar equivalent; US$100 billion refers to Canadian pension-fund investment in India.
